dedupe_keys.name: ukraine field boundary delineation 2021 2022 and 2023 nasa harvest planet 3 m

description: These three yearly datasets give delineated crop field boundaries across Ukraine for 2021, 2022 and 2023, over 5 million fields in all. The Zenodo records say they were produced from Planet bi-weekly 3 m image composites in Google Earth Engine and checked against 12,331 field boundaries from GPS-equipped combine harvesters, with a median intersection over union of 0.77 across oblasts and years. They were published in July 2024 by Yuval Sadeh of NASA Harvest with authors at Monash University, the University of Maryland and the University of Strasbourg, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as zipped files per oblast (the 2021 record alone is about 19 GB). Coverage is Ukraine, including Crimea and eastern oblasts. Caveats: boundaries are automated, and accuracy varies by oblast and year. For simulation it gives field-level agricultural assets before and during the war to estimate crop area losses and exposure to conflict and weather hazards. Related catalogue records include the Ukraine 10 m crop type map for 2020 and war losses and the EU field boundaries with crop types.
